row.notes: myteam-g2: Two-level Robin-Hood lookup: team key in comp+0x8e8 map (entry stride 0x18, value ptr +0x10), then driver key in that team's own map (entry+0x20..0x54). Returns the contract record pointer or 0. Hash=(id)*mult;h^=h>>33 open-addressing Robin-Hood map (key packed as u32: byte kind @+0, ushort id @+2).

verify.notes: V9033 Outer map at comp+0x8e8 (entry stride 0x18, value pointer at +0x10), inner map inside that record at +0x20..+0x54 with the same layout, returns inner value pointer or 0. Key is a ushort (kind<<14 | id) hashed multiplicatively with >>33 xor, Robin-Hood probing.
